rows.originalCriterion: `Timesheets.TimeSheet.Submit` takes a time sheet no. (or resource + date) and optional line nos. (default all open lines) and answers the submitted lines and their new status.
rows.originalProof: AL unit test (happy path) + MCP on bc28-w1

rows.originalCriterion: Refusal: when the caller is not the time sheet owner, the type answers code `PermissionDenied` with a `nextStep` that says: "Only the owner can submit; ask the owner." Nothing is written.
Refusal: when no open lines to submit, the type answers code `PreconditionFailed` with a `nextStep` that says: "Add lines first." Nothing is written.

Refusal: when a line fails the BC submit check (for example a blocked project task), the type answers code `InvalidLine` with a `nextStep` that says: "Fix the line and submit again." Nothing is written.

Common refusals: a missing required key answers `MissingParameter`, a wrong-typed key `InvalidParameterFormat`, an unknown key `UnknownParameter`, an identifier that matches nothing `RecordNotFound`, and conflicting identifiers `ConflictingIdentifiers`; each with `nextStep`.
Edge case: Submitting lines that are already submitted answers success with `changed: false` for those lines.

Permissions: IsEnabled and Execute check write permission on every table the type touches; a caller without it gets `PermissionDenied` with a `nextStep` naming the permission set. Grants live on BIFROST Timeshts ori (and the Full extension) (feature app: no assignable set, no `Setup ori` grants). Hot-path reads of base-app tables are granted or guarded with `ReadPermission()`.
rows.notes: Both actual restrictive permission tests95617 pass; transitive detail-write gate retained. Current permission set union preserves main and Submit grants.

rows.originalCriterion: Dedicated type blocks generic writes: a subscriber to the Foundation write-restriction event (the Foundation write-restriction event (subscriber in this app)) sets a field-level block for Time Sheet Line: Status (field-level block, changed only through the Timesheets types), so `Data.Records.Set` is refused there and points to `Timesheets.TimeSheet.Submit`. Reads stay allowed.

Writes go through Validate and the BC codeunits/reports named above (never direct Insert/Modify of ledger or posted tables), inside the write-isolation `Codeunit.Run` pattern so a failure answers a clean error and not a raw runtime error. Post/Register types commit and the help says so (core#985).
